PINELEAF FITNESS CENTER — UPDATED GROUP CLASS POLICY

Beginning 1 March, the following policies will apply to all group exercise classes at Pineleaf Fitness Center.

Reservations: Members may book classes up to seven days in advance through the member portal. Each member may hold no more than three active reservations at one time.

Thank you for serving as a volunteer floor warden during the fire drill held at Marsh Tower on 22 May. This letter summarizes the observations recorded by our team and the actions we ask you to share with staff on the fourth floor.

INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING THE EXPORT DECLARATION — FORM CD-7
Issued by Calverton Freight Services for business customers

All international shipments valued above $250 must be accompanied by a completed Form CD-7. Follow the steps below to avoid customs delays.

Step 1: In Section A, enter the full legal name and address of both the exporter and the recipient. Post-office boxes are not accepted for the recipient field.

Step 2: In Section B, describe each item in plain language. Vague terms such as 'parts' or 'samples' will be rejected by customs officers. Include the quantity, unit value, and country of manufacture for every line.

Step 3: In Section C, enter the six-digit tariff classification code. If you do not know the code, leave the field as (blank) and our brokerage team will complete it for a $12 service fee per shipment.

Step 4: Sign and date Section D. Unsigned forms are returned to the sender, and the shipment is held at our depot for up to five business days before being sent back.

Completed forms may be submitted online or handed to the driver at pickup. For assistance, call our customs help line at 555-0142, weekdays 8 A.M. to 6 P.M.

options: All domestic shipments
